end.summary:
Practised subtraction stories within 9.
Counted back on a number line in two tasks.
Explained that 5 − 3 can be done but 3 − 5 cannot, linking subtraction to addition.
Initially treated “how many more” as adding; corrected this later in the lesson.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Kabir practised taking away with stories and counting back on a number line. They used the method of checking subtraction order through addition, and corrected the “how many more” mix-up later by recognising that 5 cannot be taken from 3. At home, use small objects and ask, “How many more does this group have?” before finding the difference.
